segments.an8.86:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
segments.an8.86:1.2: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an8.86:1.4: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.an8.86:1.5: Taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato –
segments.an8.86:1.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’”ti.
segments.an8.86:2.1: Atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahutaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
segments.an8.86:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
segments.an8.86:2.3: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi –
segments.an8.86:2.4: “ke pana te, nāgita, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti?
segments.an8.86:2.5: “Ete, bhante, icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahutaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaṃyeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcā”ti.
segments.an8.86:2.6: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an8.86:2.7: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. Yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī [nikāmalābhī assaṃ (bahūsu) a. ni.5.30 passitabbaṃ. tattha hi ayaṃ pāṭhabhedā natthi] akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
segments.an8.86:2.8: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā”ti.
segments.an8.86:3.3: Yena yeneva dāni, bhante, bhagavā gamissati tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an8.86:3.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante, thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti;
segments.an8.86:3.5: evamevaṃ kho, bhante, yena yeneva dāni bhagavā gamissati tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
segments.an8.86:4.1: “Māhaṃ, nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
segments.an8.86:4.2: Yo kho, nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. Yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
segments.an8.86:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
segments.an8.86:5.1: “Devatāpi kho, nāgita, ekaccā nayimassa [ekaccā imassa (?)] nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhiniyo assu [idaṃ padaṃ katthaci natthi] akicchalābhiniyo [nikāmalābhiniyo akicchalābhiniyo (?)] akasiralābhiniyo, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an8.86:5.2: Tumhākampi [tāsampi (?)] kho, nāgita, saṅgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ [anuyutte viharante disvā (?)] evaṃ hoti –
segments.an8.86:5.3: ‘na hi nūname [na hanūname (sī. syā. pī.)] āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu [idaṃ padaṃ katthaci natthi] akicchalābhino akasiralābhino. Yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an8.86:5.4: Tathā hi pana me āyasmanto saṅgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttā viharanti’”.
segments.an8.86:6.1: “Idhāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhū passāmi aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakena [aṅgulipatodakehi (sī. pī. ka.)] sañjagghante saṅkīḷante.
segments.an8.86:6.3: ‘na hi nūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino. Yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an8.86:6.4: Tathā hi pana me āyasmanto aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakena sañjagghanti saṅkīḷanti’”.
segments.an8.86:7.1: “Idha panāhaṃ [idhāhaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)], nāgita, bhikkhū passāmi yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutte viharante.
segments.an8.86:7.3: ‘na hi nūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino. Yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an8.86:7.4: Tathā hi pana me āyasmanto yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti’”.
segments.an8.86:8.1: “Idhāhaṃ [idha panāhaṃ (?)], nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an8.86:8.3: ‘idāni imaṃ [idānimaṃ (katthaci) a. ni.6.42] āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā upaṭṭhahissati [paccessati (sī. pī.), upaṭṭhahati (ka.)] samaṇuddeso vā. Taṃ tamhā [so tamhā (ka. sī.), so taṃ tamhā (?)] samādhimhā cāvessatī’ti.
segments.an8.86:8.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena.
segments.an8.86:9.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an8.86:9.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃyeva manasi karissati ekattan’ti.
segments.an8.86:9.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an8.86:10.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an8.86:10.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati [samādahessati (katthaci)], samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī’ti.
segments.an8.86:10.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an8.86:11.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an8.86:11.3: ‘idāni ayamāyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccissati, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatī’ti.
segments.an8.86:11.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
segments.an8.86:12.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.an8.86:12.2: So taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nikāmayamāno riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni;
segments.an8.86:12.4: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena.
segments.an8.86:13.1: “Idha panāhaṃ, nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññikaṃ lābhiṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
segments.an8.86:13.2: So taṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ paṭipaṇāmetvā na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, na riñcati araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni.
segments.an8.86:13.3: Tenāhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.[[] etthantare pāṭho a. ni. 42 chakkanipāteyeva dissati, na ettha aṭṭhakanipāte]
segments.an8.86:14.1: “Yasmāhaṃ [yasmiṃhaṃ (katthaci)], nāgita, samaye addhānamaggappaṭipanno na kañci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me, nāgita, tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyā”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe mā ca mayā yasoti yaso ca mayā saddhiṃ mā gañchi.
Na hi nūnameti na hi nūna ime.
Tathā hi panameti tathā hi pana ime.
